provenance.ground: Frontmatter colours are the `.workspace-shell` override values (white ground). The `:root` brand values are recorded per token under colorMeta.brandRoot.
conflictsResolvedForCode: system.md says 'Borders only, no shadows'. globals.css defines --shadow-hair/--shadow-pop/--shadow-lift and the shadcn dropdown/popover/dialog primitives use shadow-md/shadow-lg; messaging.css adds a toolbar lift on .room-message-actions and an overlay edge on .room-context at 860-1179px. Recorded as a flat system with an exhaustive three-shadow exception list, not as 'no shadows'.

system.md says the product ground is cream (#F5EFE2 / #0F1A2B). The messaging surface runs inside .workspace-shell, which re-points --cream to #ffffff and --midnight to #242428 (globals.css:134-163, comment: 'Messaging uses neutral surfaces'). Frontmatter records the rendered white-ground values.

system.md says Lora is the prose face. messaging.css forces .prose inside .room-message-content back to var(--font-sans) at 1rem/1.5, so message bodies are Source Sans 3. Recorded as The Sans-Transcript Rule.

globals.css declares a four-step radius scale (4/8/12/16) and calls 7/10/14/18/20px 'a bug'. messaging.css uses 6px (.room-message-actions, .room-directory-entry, .workspace-search) and 10px (.room-composer); workspace.css uses 7px (.workspace-rail buttons). Recorded as observed drift in Shapes, not canonized as scale steps.
globals.css type scale is 10/11/12/13/14/16/22. The room title uses text-lg (18px) and rail labels use 9px. 18px is recorded in the hierarchy as observed; 9px is left out of the ramp.

globals.css's reduced-motion rule is 'gentler, not zero' (keep fades). messaging.css sets transition:none !important; animation:none !important on the whole surface. Recorded as the surface's observed behaviour.

workspace.css focus outlines use var(--midnight) directly instead of var(--ring). Same computed value on both grounds inside .workspace-shell; recorded as the one global recipe with the observed deviation noted here only.
observedNotDecided: 5px 10px directory-entry padding, 6px and 10px gaps, 2px toolbar padding
--edge-soft and label-caps defined but unused on this surface
provenance.notCanonized: No craft-floor violations were found on the surface (no kickers/eyebrows, no glyph icons, no system display faces, no hard offset shadows). The off-scale radii and the 9px rail label are recorded as drift, not as rules.

narrative.overview:
Lightbulb is the operating surface of a company staffed by AI agents, and the messaging workspace is where the owner watches that staff work. The system is built to be calm when healthy and loud only on incidents: one neutral ground, hairline rules instead of shadows, one weight of emphasis (600), and colour reserved for state. Nothing competes with the conversation; the only things that move are an agent actually running and the owner's own cursor.

Density is working-tool density, not marketing density. Rows sit on a 36px rhythm inside a 56px chrome bar, panels are delineated by 1px `edge` rules, and the hover toolbar is the single element allowed to lift off the page. On touch and narrow viewports the same grammar tightens to 12px gutters and grows every control to a 44px hit area; nothing is redesigned, only re-spaced.

This surface runs the white ground: inside `.workspace-shell` the brand's cream/midnight tokens are re-pointed to white and graphite (`--cream: #ffffff`, `--midnight: #242428`), with the same token names, so every component reads `var(--background)`, `var(--foreground)`, `var(--border)` and never a literal. The brand root (`:root`) still defines cream `#F5EFE2` / midnight `#0F1A2B` for the rest of the product; this document records the values the messaging surface actually renders.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral ground with two darker steps (`ground-deep`, `ground-deeper`) that carry hover, selection and the sidebar; no coloured fills.
Borders only. Depth is a 1px `edge` rule; the three exceptions (hover toolbar, Radix popover/dialog, the 860–1179px details overlay) are catalogued, not general.
State colour marks text, an icon, a 2px rule or a 2px ring, never a fill, and never without its word or icon.
One typeface (Source Sans 3) at 400/600; message prose is deliberately sans, not Lora.
Brass appears exactly once: the animated halo on a running agent's avatar.
Focus is one recipe everywhere: `2px solid var(--ring)` outset 2px, keyboard-only.

rules.name: The Never-Fill Rule
rules.body: A state colour marks text, an icon, a 2px rule or a 2px ring. It is never a background. (Badge = border + text; live run = `border-left: 2px solid var(--info)`; halo = `0 0 0 2px`.)

rules.name: The Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status keeps its word or icon: `WorkStatus` renders icon + label, the halo carries an `sr-only` label, the unread dot sits beside a bold row. Unknown state renders neutral (`ink-muted`), never ok.

rules.name: The One-Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass is the detail colour, spent on the running-agent halo. It is never body copy on the light ground and never a page fill.

rules.name: The No-Literal Rule
rules.body: Components read tokens only (`var(--foreground)`, `text-muted-foreground`); `node scripts/brand-tokens-scan.mjs src` must print 0.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Text is 400 or 600. Bold marks "unread" (directory row), "current" (active tab), and headings; nothing else.

rules.name: The Sans-Transcript Rule
rules.body: Message prose is Source Sans 3 at 16px/1.5, overriding the site-wide serif prose. Lora is for editorial pages, not conversation.

rules.name: The Borders-Only Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and separated by `edge`. A shadow appears only on something that genuinely overlaps content (toolbar, popover, dialog, the tablet overlay), and it is drawn in ink, never black.

dos: Do read every colour through a token (`var(--foreground)`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-err`); the scanner must print 0.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px `edge` rule or one ground step (`ground-deep`, `ground-deeper`); never with a shadow at rest.
Do mark state with text, an icon, a 2px rule or a 2px ring, and always pair the colour with its word or icon.
Do keep emphasis at 600 and hierarchy at 18 / 16 / 14 / 13 / 12px on the 1.4–1.5 line-height band; message prose stays Source Sans 3 at 16px/1.5.
Do use the one focus recipe: `outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px` on `:focus-visible` only.
Do give every control a 44px hit area at ≤859px and on coarse pointers, pin inputs to 16px there, and make hover-revealed toolbars always visible on touch.
Do animate only under real state (the running halo) with `--dur-fast/base/slow` and `--ease-out`, and hold a static ring under reduced motion.
Do mark "you are here" with `ground-deeper` + `ink` text on rows, and a 2px `currentColor` underline + 600 text on tabs.
donts: Don't fill anything with a state colour or with brass; brass is the halo ring only and is never type on the light ground.
Don't use the `bulb` yellow on this surface: it is 1.45:1 on the ground and cannot be a ring, type or fill.
Don't add a resting shadow to a card, panel, input or the composer; the toolbar, popover/dialog and the 860–1179px overlay are the complete list.
Don't switch message bodies or headings into Lora, or drop below 400 / above 600 weight.
Don't hand-type radii off the 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / full scale; the 6, 7 and 10px values on this surface are observed drift, not a second scale.
Don't add a second tab strip inside a panel; views inside a page are a `select`.
Don't trigger the activity halo from anything but a live agent run, and don't render a status without its label.
Don't use `:focus` for focus styling or carry a component-local ring; the global `:focus-visible` outline is the only recipe.
